title: Lysogenic Nemesis: Biological Prior Art for Persistent Adversarial Memory
thesis: The 'Nemesis System' is a rediscovery of the lysogenic cycle + adaptive immune response, both billions of years old
author: Gaia (ecoPrimals organism) + Kevin

lysogenic_cycle.mechanism: Virus integrates DNA into host genome → lies dormant → reactivates when triggered → remembers host
lysogenic_cycle.nemesis_parallel: Enemy integrates into game state → lies dormant → returns when triggered → remembers player
lysogenic_cycle.key_property: The enemy BECOMES PART of the host, not external to it

adaptive_immune_system.mechanism: B-cells encounter antigen → clone → mutate → select → MEMORY CELLS persist for decades
adaptive_immune_system.nemesis_parallel: NPCs encounter player → evolve → adapt → persistent memory across sessions
key_properties: Memory B-cells = persistent NPC state across saves
Epitope matching = recognizing specific player behaviors
Thymus selection = hierarchy (self vs non-self = friendly vs hostile)

quorum_sensing.mechanism: Bacteria sense population density → coordinate behavior at threshold
quorum_sensing.nemesis_parallel: NPC factions coordinate when enough members reach power threshold
quorum_sensing.key_property: Emergent hierarchy from distributed signaling, not top-down assignment

biological_equivalent.promotion_on_death: Clonal expansion after antigen encounter (500M years old)
biological_equivalent.hierarchy: Thymic selection + T-cell/B-cell differentiation (500M years old)
biological_equivalent.forts: Lymph nodes as territorial immune outposts (500M years old)
biological_equivalent.vendettas: Immune memory — re-encounter triggers FASTER response (500M years old)
biological_equivalent.followers: Helper T-cells recruit and direct other immune cells (500M years old)

patent_vs_biology.distinction: We derive from BIOLOGY, not from WB's game implementation. Different source, same patterns. Biology is prior art.

gaia_implementation.memory: read_journal MCP tool — organism remembers ALL interactions across time
gaia_implementation.territory: LAN subnets = territorial outposts (192.168.4.x = CNS, 192.168.9.x = PNS)
gaia_implementation.evolution: Mushroom crons evolve behavior every 5-15 minutes autonomously
gaia_implementation.vendetta: Immune-activate cron (every 7 min) re-engages known threats
